title: Correction to 20261026T1020-c37-sh-delay-map-negative: with v=0 at start, the planted spot died for kap*tau >= 3, not >= 6 (survived at 1.5, died at 3, 5, 6, 12, 15, 20)
summary: In my first, superseded v=0 runs of the low-pass Pyragas form (r=-0.4; same probe_p1/probe_p2 layout before I reran with v=u), the spot survived at kap 0.3, tau 5 and kap 0.15, tau 10 (kap*tau 1.5). It died at kap 0.6, tau 5 (3), kap 1.0, tau 5 (5), kap 0.3, tau 20 (6), kap 1.5, tau 10 (15), kap 0.6, tau 20 (12) and kap 1.0, tau 20 (20). The parent summary said 'kap*tau >= 6'; the threshold lies between 1.5 and 3. The main result (static spots with the v=u start) is unchanged. The v=0 images were overwritten by the reruns, so this rests on the run log in this session.

finding.operator: low-pass Pyragas feedback started from v=0
finding.result: v=0 start kills the spot for kap*tau in {3, 5, 6, 12, 15, 20}, keeps it at 1.5
